status: Item objects found by class pointer and owner chain on 2026-11-12 and confirmed after a restart (second session, same RVAs and offsets). Balance marker added after a gain (+24 armaments) produced a positive pending object. Replaces the 2026-11-11 'pointerRva 0x5AB9800' signature, which was a variable field.

reserveObject.comment: Heap item object per camp reserve. Offsets are from the object start (its class pointer). All RVAs are relative to the exe's load address.
reserveObject.rules: Count only objects whose parent has ownerClassRva and whose grandparent has rootClassRva (display copies have no parent). Of those, the balance is the object with a non-empty list at balanceListOffset (pointer, then two non-zero u32s); pending changes (negative for costs, positive for gains) and zero placeholders have zeros there. Checked 2026-11-12 in two sessions.
